summary: Compressor with four characters (Clean VCA, Glue bus, FET, Opto), knee, lookahead, an external sidechain on input 2 and parallel mix. Use it to control dynamics, glue a bus, or duck a track under a kick.
use_for: Level control and bus glue with four characters, sidechain and parallel mix.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: Clean: transparent VCA. Glue: bus VCA. FET: fast feedback. Opto: smooth, program-dependent
parameters.how: Chooses the compressor's character: Clean transparent, Glue for buses, FET fast and punchy, Opto slow and smooth.
parameters.sound: Clean stays out of the way, Glue binds a mix together, FET adds bite and Opto feels gentle and rounded.

parameters.name: Threshold
parameters.how: Sets the level in dB, from -60 to 0, above which the compressor starts turning the signal down.
parameters.sound: A lower threshold compresses more of the signal and makes the sound more even and dense.

parameters.name: Ratio
parameters.how: Sets how strongly signal above the threshold is reduced, from 1:1 up to 20:1 and limiting at the top.
parameters.sound: Low ratios are gentle and natural; high ratios flatten the peaks and give a squashed, controlled sound.

parameters.name: Knee
parameters.how: Sets how gradually compression sets in around the threshold, from 0 to 24 dB.
parameters.sound: A wide knee is smooth and hard to notice; a narrow one grabs suddenly and sounds firmer.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Time to 63 % of the gain change
parameters.how: Sets how fast the gain falls once the signal passes the threshold, from 0.05 ms to 200 ms.
parameters.sound: Fast attacks tame transients and dull the punch; slow ones let the hit through before the squeeze.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Time back to 37 % of the gain change
parameters.how: Sets how fast the gain recovers after the signal drops, from 5 ms to 3 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases sound lively and can pump; long ones sound smooth and steady.

parameters.name: Auto release
parameters.description: Program-dependent release: fast after transients, slow under sustained compression
parameters.how: Lets the release time follow the material: fast after sharp hits, slow under sustained loud passages.
parameters.sound: It sounds more natural and pumps less than a fixed release on mixed material.

parameters.name: Sidechain
parameters.description: Detect from the input, or from input 2 (connect a machine to the second input)
parameters.how: Chooses whether the compressor listens to its own input or to the machine connected to the second input.
parameters.sound: External lets another sound, such as a kick, duck this one for a pumping effect.

parameters.name: SC low cut
parameters.description: High-pass on the detector: lets the lows through uncompressed
parameters.how: Filters the low frequencies, from 10 to 500 Hz, out of the signal the compressor listens to.
parameters.sound: Bass no longer triggers heavy squeezing, so the lows stay full while the rest is controlled.

parameters.name: Lookahead
parameters.description: Delays the audio so the detector sees peaks coming (adds latency)
parameters.how: Delays the audio by up to 5 ms so the compressor sees peaks before they arrive.
parameters.sound: Fast peaks are caught cleanly without a click at the start, at the cost of a little latency.

parameters.name: Stereo link
parameters.description: 100 %: both channels get the same gain
parameters.how: Sets how much both channels share the same gain reduction, from independent (0 %) to fully linked (100 %).
parameters.sound: Linked keeps the stereo image steady; unlinked can widen it but may shift the image on loud one-sided parts.

parameters.name: Makeup
parameters.how: Adds 0 to 24 dB of gain after compression.
parameters.sound: It brings the level back up after the squeeze, so the compressed sound seems fuller and louder.

parameters.name: Auto makeup
parameters.description: Adds the gain a −12 dBFS signal loses
parameters.how: Adds the gain that a -12 dBFS signal loses to compression, automatically.
parameters.sound: The level stays about the same as you change Threshold and Ratio, so you hear the character, not the volume.

parameters.name: Character
parameters.description: Mode colour: Glue VCA, FET and Opto saturation (Clean ignores it)
parameters.how: Sets how strongly the chosen mode adds its own colour: Glue VCA, FET and Opto saturation (Clean ignores it).
parameters.sound: More character adds warmth and density to the compressed sound.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.how: Blends the compressed signal with the dry signal.
parameters.sound: Mixing some dry back in keeps the punch and detail while adding density, known as parallel compression.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.how: Sets the final level in dB, from -24 to +24.
parameters.sound: It makes the whole sound louder or quieter without changing its tone.
